message.content:
1) Crispness: The icons appear as smooth 3D renders with clean edges — no visible pixelation or blur, so at ~128px they look crisp (likely SVG/PNG at sufficient resolution). ✅

2) Placement: Each icon sits at the RTL start (right) side of its heading, e.g. beside «خلاصهٔ روزانهٔ بازار طلا» and «نگارش ماهانهٔ شوارای جهانی طلا». However, on the first card the icon extends slightly beyond the card's top-right edge and touches/crowds the text baseline area — minor spacing improvement (small padding/margin between icon and heading, and clipping containment) would help. ⚠️

3) Balance: The layout is largely intentional — RTL heading left of icon, AI-translated badge at the left edge, content below. But the large icon makes the header feel top-heavy with a lot of empty space left of the heading on wide cards; slightly reducing icon size or vertically centering header content would improve balance. ⚠️
